mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO conversation (id, type, user_low_id, user_high_id) VALUES (#{id}, 0, #{userLowId}, #{userHighId})
INSERT INTO conversation (id, type, group_id) VALUES (#{id}, 1, #{groupId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, type, user_low_id, user_high_id, group_id, user_low_last_sync_message_id, user_high_last_sync_message_id, last_message_id, last_message_time, create_time, update_time FROM conversation WHERE type = 0 AND user_low_id = #{userLowId} AND user_high_id = #{userHighId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, type, user_low_id, user_high_id, group_id, user_low_last_sync_message_id, user_high_last_sync_message_id, last_message_id, last_message_time, create_time, update_time FROM conversation WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id, c.type, c.user_low_id, c.user_high_id, c.group_id, c.user_low_last_sync_message_id, c.user_high_last_sync_message_id, c.last_message_id, c.last_message_time, c.create_time, c.update_time FROM conversation c LEFT JOIN group_chat_member gcm ON c.type = 1 AND c.group_id = gcm.group_id AND gcm.user_id = #{userId} WHERE c.user_low_id = #{userId} OR c.user_high_id = #{userId} OR gcm.user_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(c.last_message_time, c.create_time) DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, type, user_low_id, user_high_id, group_id, user_low_last_sync_message_id, user_high_last_sync_message_id, last_message_id, last_message_time, create_time, update_time FROM conversation WHERE type = 1 AND group_id = #{groupId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation SET last_message_id = #{messageId}, last_message_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{conversationId}
